exposure: Polygenic risk scores for bipolar disorder
outcome: Being delivered via planned cesarean section
Being delivered via acute cesarean section
cohort: The study involved 17,050 genotyped individuals (8382 females, 8668 males) born between 1996 and 2008 from a general population representative sub-cohort.
finding: While polygenic risk scores for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression, autism, and ADHD were not overall associated with being delivered via cesarean section, subgroup analyses found positive associations between polygenic risk scores for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and depression with planned cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Polygenic risk scores for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and depression were positively associated with delivery via planned cesarean section, but this association was not observed for acute cesarean sections.
